title: 第09章 真实的谎言

content_zh:
叶小天仿佛又回到了刑部大牢，正在振振有词地给犯官们洗脑，给狱卒们正名：“杨大人三年前入狱，小天我也是三年前做的狱卒，从那时起，杨大人便时常教我起卦、教我做人的道理。
‘眼为田宅主其宫，清秀分明一样同。若是阴阳枯骨露，父母家财总是空’，这就是杨大人教我背的《麻衣相术》里的一首卦辞。这个暂且不谈。总之杨大人是很欣赏我的，他还说我相貌不凡，一生富贵。”
叶小天道：“那天，朝廷降旨，杨大人要于次日问斩，我就为杨大人打了几角酒，要了几道下酒的小菜，当时牢里头很黑，外面还下着雨，我点了一根蜡烛，烛光下，杨大人泪流不止……”
胡县令、杨夫人、三瘦大总管以及所有前来吊唁的客人愣愣地听他说着，叶小天那小嘴吧吧吧的语速极快，他们根本插不上嘴。叶小天就像一个最敬业的演员，非常投入地表演着。
叶小天脸上现出悲戚之色，黯然道：“杨大人说：‘小天啊，老夫入狱三年，旧友皆然不见，亲人也是无踪，唯有你，算是老夫的忘年之交了，老夫临终之际，唯有一个放不下的人，那就是我的女儿，老夫把她托付给你，可好？’”
听到“入狱三年，旧友皆然不见，亲人也是无踪”时，杨夫人的脸颊热了一下，羞愧地低下头去，但是她的头刚刚低下，听到后面一句，就猛地又抬了起来，因为动作太快，似乎听到后颈的骨节都咔吧一响。
堂上院中，一时间鸦雀无声。
“当……当当当当当……”
一只锁呐在地上弹动了几下，那是墙角吹锁呐的乐师失手掉落的，一个念经的大和尚举起铜钹蹭了蹭光头，左顾右盼。那清丽无双的女子本来正垂泪不止，此时却瞪大一双迷离的泪眼，看着叶小天错愕不已。
叶小天幽幽一声长叹，仰起头来道：“小天我出身卑贱，家境贫寒，自然是配不上杨家贵女的，可杨大人说，经此一劫，他已勘破世事，觉得什么大富之家，都不如做一个太平人家的好……”
叶小天越说越动情，再低头时，眸中已是泪光隐隐，他被自己编出来的瞎话感动了。
杨霖素来夫妻不和，而且很清楚妻子对爱女的嫌恶，知道只要他一死，夫人必然会虐待爱女。而叶小天呢，杨霖则对他赏识有加。
叶小天对杨霖有恩，痴迷相术的杨霖又相信叶小天会一生太平富贵，那么……，杨霖在临终之际，鉴于家中情形，做出这样一个在别人看来有些古怪的决定，也就合乎情理了。
叶小天望向胡县令，沉声道：“杨大人……啊不！我的岳父大人在信上还说，要令小天接了娘子与岳母一并回京，以竭诚奉养。岳父大人临终之际，最担心的就是家门不合，以致遗人笑柄啊！”
叶小天加这一句，无非是想到若只带了那俏生生的小娘子离开，她牵挂老娘，不免要终日以泪洗面，说不定还要对自己心生怨尤，不如把她老娘一并接走，家里再穷也不差多一个妇人的口粮。
胡县令低头看看遗书，再抬头看看叶小天，瞠目结舌地说不出话来，只有颌下的胡须瑟瑟发抖。
叶小天心道：“老家伙，我让步了，我可已经让步了，我连五百两银子都不要了，还要把你们的眼中钉带走，你可不要欺人太甚，杀人不过头点地，得饶人处且饶人啊！”
胡知县想着书信上的内容，再想想叶小天说过的话，看着叶小天一脸坦然的神情，只觉得无比荒诞，心思都有些混乱了，这个小子怎么就能瞪着眼睛编瞎话儿，还能说的这么情真意切？
否认他说的话，顺手撕掉这封信么？倒也不是不可以，可这样一来，旁人难免心生猜忌，相信了叶小天的话，对自己的官声大大不利。
如果是涉及到分割家产，那就豁出去毁信杀人，旁人些许风言风语也顾不得理会了。但是现在叶小天什么都不要，还替他顺手解决了眼中钉的问题，有什么理由不答应呢？

胡知县的眼神闪烁了一下，忽然呵呵地笑了起来。
他微笑着收起书信，往袖筒里一塞，从容说道：“信中果然是这么说的，以老夫看来，此举着实有些荒唐。然则妹婿一向率性，也难怪他会有此决定。既是妹婿临终之际，老夫又怎好违逆？三瘦啊，你去把小姐请来。”

content_en:
Ye Xiaotian seemed to be back in the prison of the Ministry of Punishment, plausibly brainwashing the prisoners and clearing the names of the jailers: "Master Yang was imprisoned three years ago. Xiaotian, I was also a jailer three years ago. Since then, Master Yang has often taught me hexagrams and the principles of life.
'The eyes of the owner of the palace are the fields, and they are equally delicate and clear. If the yin and yang are withered and the bones are exposed, the wealth of the parents will always be empty.' This is a hexagram in the "Ma Yi Xiang Shu" that Mr. Yang taught me to memorize. Let’s not talk about this for now. In short, Mr. Yang admires me very much. He also said that I have extraordinary appearance and will be rich in my life. "
Ye Xiaotian said: "That day, the court issued a decree that Mr. Yang would be executed the next day, so I bought Mr. Yang a few cents of wine and ordered some side dishes to go with the wine. It was dark inside the prison and it was raining outside. I lit a candle. Under the candlelight, Mr. Yang couldn't stop crying..."
Magistrate Hu, Mrs. Yang, the Third Slender Manager and all the guests who came to express their condolences listened to him in a daze. Ye Xiaotian's little mouth was talking so fast that they couldn't get a word in at all. Ye Xiaotian is like the most dedicated actor, performing very devotedly.
Ye Xiaotian showed sadness on his face and said sadly: "Master Yang said: 'My dear, I have been in prison for three years. All my old friends have disappeared, and my relatives have disappeared. You are the only one who is my best friend. When I am dying, there is only one person I can't let go of, and that is my daughter. I entrust her to you, okay?'"
When she heard "I have been in prison for three years, all my old friends have disappeared, and my relatives have disappeared." Mrs. Yang's cheeks heated up and she lowered her head in shame. But just as she lowered her head, when she heard the next sentence, she suddenly raised it up again. Because she moved so fast, she seemed to hear the joints in the back of her neck snap.
There was silence in the hall and courtyard for a while.
"Dang...dang dang dang..."
A suo na bounced on the ground a few times. It was dropped by the musician playing the suo na in the corner. A great monk who was chanting sutras raised his copper cymbal and rubbed his bald head, looking left and right. The beautiful and unparalleled woman was originally crying, but now her eyes widened with blurred tears, looking at Ye Xiaotian in astonishment.
Ye Xiaotian let out a deep sigh, raised his head and said, "Xiaotian, I come from a humble background and my family is poor. Naturally, I am not worthy of the noble daughter of the Yang family. But Mr. Yang said that after this calamity, he has figured out the world and feels that any wealthy family is not as good as being from a peaceful family..."
Ye Xiaotian became more and more emotional as he spoke. When he lowered his head again, there were tears in his eyes. He was moved by the lies he made up.
Yang Lin has always been at odds with his wife, and he is very aware of his wife's dislike of her beloved daughter. He knows that as long as he dies, his wife will definitely abuse her beloved daughter. As for Ye Xiaotian, Yang Lin admired him very much.
Ye Xiaotian was kind to Yang Lin, and Yang Lin, who was obsessed with physiognomy, believed that Ye Xiaotian would live a peaceful and prosperous life, so... it was reasonable for Yang Lin to make such a strange decision in the eyes of others when he was dying, considering the situation at home.
Ye Xiaotian looked at Magistrate Hu and said in a deep voice: "Mr. Yang... ah no! My father-in-law also said in the letter that he would ask Xiaotian to take his wife back to Beijing with her mother-in-law to support her wholeheartedly. When my father-in-law was dying, what he was most worried about was that the family did not get along and that he would be laughed at by his widow!"
Ye Xiaotian added this sentence just because he thought that if he only took the pretty little lady away, she would inevitably shed tears all day long because she cared about her, and might even feel resentful towards herself. He might as well take her away with him. No matter how poor the family was, it would not be short of the food rations of one more woman.
Magistrate Hu lowered his head to look at the suicide note, then looked up at Ye Xiaotian. He was speechless and speechless, only the beard under his chin was trembling.
Ye Xiaotian said in his heart: "Old guy, I gave in, I have already given in, I don't even want five hundred taels of silver, and I want to take away the thorn in your side. Don't bully people too much. You can't kill people without a nod. You have to be merciful and merciful!""
Hu Zhixian thought about the content of the letter, and then what Ye Xiaotian had said. Looking at Ye Xiaotian's calm expression, he felt that it was extremely absurd, and his mind was a little confused. How could this kid make up lies with his eyes wide open, and still speak so sincerely?
Deny what he said and tear up the letter? It's not impossible, but in this case, others will inevitably become suspicious and believe Ye Xiaotian's words, which will be greatly detrimental to his official reputation.
If it involves dividing family property, then go all out to destroy trust and kill people, and ignore the rumors from others. But now Ye Xiaotian doesn't want anything, and he has solved the problem that was a thorn in his side. What reason is there for not agreeing?
Hu Zhixian's eyes flickered and he suddenly laughed.
He put away the letter with a smile, stuffed it into his sleeve, and said calmly: "That's what the letter said. In my opinion, this move is really ridiculous. But my sister-in-law has always been straightforward, so it's no wonder he made this decision. Since my sister-in-law is on his deathbed, how can I disobey him? Sanshou, go and invite the lady. "
